WITH joined AS (
  SELECT o.timespan
  FROM orders o
  INNER JOIN riskandmargin rm ON rm.ordervault = o.recordvault
),
aggregated AS (
  SELECT timespan, COUNT(*) as record_count
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY timespan
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(record_count) as total_records, 
    COUNT(*) as num_timespans
  FROM aggregated
)
SELECT 
  a.timespan,
  a.record_count,
  (a.record_count::numeric) / (t.total_records::numeric) as share,
  (a.record_count::numeric) / (t.total_records::numeric) - (1::numeric) / (t.num_timespans::numeric) as diff_from_avg
FROM aggregated a
CROSS JOIN totals t
ORDER BY a.timespan;
